note: A product decision, not a legal one. It changes what may be sold and by which path; it changes no legal conclusion, no eligibility rule and no route's service disposition. No signature or approval method is represented here beyond the instruction as given.
decisionSource: Explicit owner instruction, recorded verbatim in decisionText.
decisionText: The legacy packet generators for Illinois, District of Columbia, Pennsylvania, Mississippi and Texas-Harris are not approved commercial fulfillment paths. Do not restore their direct-consumer price. Do not create a state-specific exception. Do not interpret any AGENTS.md preservation rule as preserving their commercial authority. They may remain temporarily only as historical evidence, implementation references, sources of reusable legal, form, map, fixture or copy assets, and comparison evidence during migration. They may not authorize checkout, sponsored entitlement, packet-credit consumption, render jobs, participant delivery, or commercially deliverable status. The Grade-A fulfillment model is the sole forward architecture.
affectedEntryPoints: partner-sponsored Mississippi packet information and legacy artifact attachment
the public partner document pages at /documents/[partnerSlug] and /documents/[partnerSlug]/[packetId]
packet attachment and Briefcase artifact refs carrying provider rcap_legacy_mississippi
the packet route resolver's LEGACY_VERIFIED_JURISDICTIONS classification
the durable render job contract and worker dispatch
commercialEffect: No legacy generator authorizes checkout, sponsored entitlement, packet-credit consumption, a render job, participant delivery, or commercially deliverable status. Commercial authority comes only from a Grade-A fulfillment record keyed to an exact route and packet family. The direct-consumer price for all five jurisdictions is closed and is not restored.
migrationEffect: Grade-A fulfillment is the sole forward architecture. Each legacy route is migrated route by route and packet family by packet family; a state is never reopened because one of its routes passes.
historicalRetentionTreatment: Legacy modules, state packs, official sources, field maps, packet text, filing instructions and fixtures are retained as assets and history. Already-generated artifacts stay reachable through protected owner-authorized access. Nothing is deleted merely because its runtime is retired.
noLegacyExceptionRule: There is no state-specific commercial exception and none may be created. A partner-only generator does not become a direct-consumer exception. Jurisdiction membership grants nothing. A route sells only what a fulfillment record proves it delivers.

supersedes.asPreviouslyRead: Existing live legacy generators must remain preserved ... Legacy generators are flow/output references and live fallbacks. Do not break them.
supersedes.asNowRead: Preservation means preserving useful assets and history. It does not mean preserving runtime or commercial authority.
